charge_port.notes: Estimated: the 2026 Mach-E has a CCS1 port (InsideEVs) and Ford sells a NACS adapter (2025 spec sheet); the Supercharger adapter programme for 2025 owners implies the same CCS1 port. No port change found across 2021-2026.

supercharger_access.notes: Ford: adapter gives Tesla Supercharger access in the U.S. and Canada (programme from 29 Feb 2024; the cited Ford page names no model years, so eligibility of this model year is not shown by it; 2025 has the feature from the factory). Recorded: via adapter today.
